title: Surreal Demoness on Teal Couch
description: A woman with dark hair and red 'DEMON' written on her forehead sits on a teal tufted couch holding a blue bowl filled with pink roses and blueberries. She is surrounded by a surreal scene featuring a gnarled tree with clocks, a large black bird, lightning in a purple sky, a full moon, and dripping red and yellow liquid from above.
prompt: A surreal scene of a young woman with dark hair and red 'DEMON' text on her forehead sitting on a teal tufted couch, holding a blue bowl of pink roses and blueberries. A gnarled tree with embedded clocks grows behind her with a large black raven perched nearby. A framed picture of roses and gears rests on the couch. Purple stormy sky with lightning and a full moon, red and yellow liquid dripping from the top right, intricate details, vibrant yet dark atmosphere.
